Focused project explicitly includes test sources; added the new staging file after a missing helper error revealed exclusion. Test connection-interface cast corrected before execution.

Before retry, lean journal confirmation stores only seed hash/revisions/time, reconstructing the typed proof from immutable seed, avoiding large original duplication/overflow. Seed bounds checked before persistence.
changes: Data-owned immutable metadata/hash/byte-count/version/language/format/subtype/UTC original and server nonce ownership seed; PERMIT_DOCUMENT_STAGE journal added to existing PERMITS Beep Migration manifest.
Reuse native SOURCE_DOCUMENT/RM_INFORMATION_ITEM/RM_FILE_CONTENT in CORE; byte array only in RM_FILE_CONTENT, no duplicate file store or arbitrary path/URL read.
Sequential owned Serializable intent/core/confirmation transactions with canonical schema keys/types/widths, exact native row/audit/content readback and current scope/target fences.

Dedicated stage-authority entry into existing application permission/grant/native FIELD guard; standard app RBAC remains owner. Stage row read policy independently includes company/FIELD/parent filters.
Read-only recorded stage outcome recovery and exact retry/convergence; reject foreign/partial/changed native data rather than adopting or repairing it.
self_review: Server runtime fingerprints are internal journal values; phase3 must project sanitized receipts instead of serializing seed target hashes. Existing work-order document authorization remains separate. Staging is not attachment linkage or current-download authority. Shared lifecycle authority behavior retained by scoped probe.
limits: No distributed atomicity: journal/core/journal commits are independent; recovery handles observed uncertainty. Faults are injected before native FILE insert/confirmation write, not power loss or a real lost CORE commit acknowledgement.

Two physical local SQLite targets use setup-installed isolated connector1.0.59/provider1.0.119 and prior changed engine runtime; metadata/defaults/author authority/fault hooks controlled for physical tests.

Controlled CORE Beep MigrationModel supplies complete native properties, canonical keys and nullable optional columns; production PPDM reference catalog/FK/metadata and other-provider acceptance remain unqualified.

No new protected HTTP/upload endpoint, client retained upload/reselect flow, live attachment link/current document comparison, authorized download, independent content-review UI, browser/OIDC/RTL/a11y acceptance is delivered in this slice. These remain required next work.

Staging restart/process failure, contention and credential/binding reconciliation beyond selected target-drift refusal remain unqualified. Existing-schema rollout, public driver distribution and overall roadmap remain open.
